source: CreatorOS release verification; docs/release/DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST.md is historical audit evidence
notes: This manifest is the single release-gate input for prerequisite version, size, SHA-256, signer,
consent and redistribution state. The FFmpeg and ffprobe values were re-hashed on the build machine.
Changing a value here without re-verifying the payload would turn a verification into a claim.

signature.expected_subject: CN=Ollama Inc., O=Ollama Inc., L=Toronto, S=Ontario, C=CA

consent.summary: Ollama is a separate product published by Ollama Inc. It is downloaded only from its official release page, after you agree, and only after the bytes match the pinned hash and the vendor signature.

license.name: MIT for Ollama
license.detail: The official installer also carries GPU runtime components under their own terms.

redistribution.detail: Not approved for v1.0.0 bundling. Acquire it from the official release instead of embedding it in the CreatorOS installer.

consent.summary: The media toolchain is expected on disk. It is not downloaded silently.

license.name: GPLv3 or later
license.detail: Built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3 --enable-libx264 and statically links libx264.

redistribution.detail: Blocked for bundling. GPLv3 needs corresponding source, build scripts and notices for this exact binary, which the repository does not yet have.

consent.summary: FFprobe is part of the same local FFmpeg build. It is verified against its own pinned SHA-256; a matching ffmpeg.exe size does not verify it.

license.name: GPLv3 or later
license.detail: Same GPLv3 build as ffmpeg.exe; no separate redistribution approval.

redistribution.detail: Blocked for bundling. GPLv3 needs corresponding source, build scripts and notices for this exact binary, which the repository does not yet have.
